title: Handling of network rejection not due to congestion control

entities.name: PDU Session Establishment Procedure
entities.description: Procedure initiated by UE to establish a PDU session with the network.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate PDU session establishment.

entities.name: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT
entities.description: Message sent by network to reject PDU session establishment request.

entities.name: Back-off timer value IE
entities.description: Information element containing timer value for back-off mechanism.

entities.name: Re-attempt indicator IE
entities.description: Information element indicating whether re-attempt is allowed in equivalent PLMNs or different RAT.

entities.name: 5GSM cause value
entities.description: Information element indicating the reason for session establishment rejection.

entities.name: Back-off timer
entities.description: Timer used to prevent UE from sending PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST for specific combinations.

entities.name: Back-off timer value IE included
entities.description: Condition where Back-off timer value IE is present in PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message.

entities.name: Timer value neither zero nor deactivated
entities.description: Condition where timer value indicates neither zero nor deactivated state.

entities.name: Timer value indicates deactivated
entities.description: Condition where timer value indicates timer is deactivated.

entities.name: Timer value indicates zero
entities.description: Condition where timer value indicates zero.

entities.name: UE starts back-off timer
entities.description: Behavior where UE starts the back-off timer with provided value.

entities.name: UE prevents PDU session establishment request
entities.description: Behavior where UE is prevented from sending PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST for specific combinations.

relations.description: PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message contains Back-off timer value IE.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message contains Re-attempt indicator IE.
PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REJECT message contains 5GSM cause value IE.
When Back-off timer value IE is included, UE starts back-off timer.
When timer value is neither zero nor deactivated, UE starts back-off timer.
When timer value is neither zero nor deactivated, UE prevents sending PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST.
When timer value indicates deactivated, UE prevents sending PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST.
When timer value indicates zero, UE may send another PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST.
UE behavior starts the back-off timer.
